assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina), human skeletal muscle; proteomics is in the paper but not in this GEO series
sample_inclusion: 12 healthy men, biopsies of m. soleus and m. vastus lateralis 14 days before and on day 20 of 21-day -6 degree head-down bed rest (GEO overall design); 48 libraries = 12 subjects x 2 muscles x 2 time points
primary_estimand: within-subject change in gene expression after 3-week disuse (bed rest) vs before, separately in calf (soleus) and thigh (vastus lateralis); the paper reports the soleus response is larger. Disuse is the inverse of the exercise/physical-activity axis: the estimand is the effect of removing loading, not of exercise training.
planned_contrasts: Soleus: after vs before bed rest, paired by subject (abstract: transcriptome changes greater in calf; count not stated in abstract)
Vastus lateralis: after vs before bed rest, paired by subject (abstract; count not stated in abstract)
paper_method: not stated in abstract; GEO data_processing: HISAT2 alignment to GRCh38, Rsubread exon counts (Ensembl 101)
paper_results: abstract: greater transcriptome change in soleus than vastus lateralis; no DEG counts or gene lists in the abstract
